ev.name: Ejenzi
ev.one_liner: An online marketplace for building and construction materials and home improvement products.
ev.source_title: 27 AFRICAN DIGITAL STARTUPS TO TAKE PART IN IHUB TRACTION CAMP ...
ev.evidence_quote: Ejenzi is an online marketplace for building and construction materials and home improvement products.
ev.divergence_summary: Same idea, but applied to non-perishable construction goods instead of farm produce.
ev.lesson: Marketplaces can effectively organize fragmented informal supply chains even outside of agriculture.
ev.transfer: Borrow the marketplace structure to create transparency and reduce broker reliance in fragmented supply chains.
ev.relationship_reason: They operate in different industries and share similar marketplace architectural challenges.

ev.name: Gametime
ev.one_liner: App for purchasing last-minute tickets for live sports and concert events.
ev.source_title: Best Last Minute Ticket App - Reddit
ev.evidence_quote: Gametime: Popular for last-minute tickets, often offering good deals.
ev.divergence_summary: Same idea, but concert tickets have a hard expiration at showtime, whereas produce perishability is more gradual.
ev.lesson: Use data to track price drops in real-time to help users identify the optimal window for buying.
ev.transfer: Implement a dynamic pricing model that lowers ticket costs as event time approaches to clear excess inventory.
ev.relationship_reason: They operate in a different industry and can share playbooks on dynamic pricing and urgency-based sales.

ev.name: TickPick
ev.one_liner: Secondary ticket marketplace with no hidden service fees for buyers.
ev.source_title: Best Last Minute Ticket App - Reddit
ev.evidence_quote: TickPick has the price you see if what you’re paying, every other site besides TiqIQ has the fees hidden, TickPick is the best way to go.
ev.divergence_summary: Same idea, but TickPick focuses on fee transparency to differentiate from competitors with hidden costs.
ev.lesson: Removing hidden intermediaries' fees creates a superior user experience and encourages repeat usage.
ev.transfer: Adopt transparent, all-in pricing to build user trust and reduce cart abandonment.
ev.relationship_reason: They serve a different market and provide a model for pricing transparency that adds value to trade platforms.

ev.name: Twiga Foods
ev.one_liner: Connects farmers directly to retailers to reduce food waste.
ev.source_title: The Tech Behind Kenyan Agri-Apps: Skills That Feed a Nation | McTaba Labs
ev.evidence_quote: Twiga Foods connects farmers directly to retailers, cutting out middlemen and reducing food waste.
ev.divergence_summary: Same idea, but utilizes web and Android apps rather than just SMS.
ev.lesson: Use a multi-channel API-first architecture to serve both low-tech farmers and high-tech urban buyers.
ev.relationship_reason: Serves the same customer base in Kenya.

ev.name: Apollo Agriculture
ev.one_liner: Provides smallholder farmers with seeds, fertilizer, and insurance.
ev.source_title: The Tech Behind Kenyan Agri-Apps: Skills That Feed a Nation | McTaba Labs
ev.evidence_quote: Apollo Agriculture provides smallholder farmers with seeds, fertilizer, and insurance bundled with satellite-based crop monitoring.
ev.divergence_summary: Same idea, but bundles financial inputs like insurance with crop supply.
ev.lesson: Bundle agricultural inputs with financial services to drive adoption.
ev.relationship_reason: Focuses on inputs rather than direct trade of perishables.

ev.name: Freshconnect
ev.one_liner: Online B2B marketplace for fresh agricultural produce like fruits & vegetables.
ev.source_title: Failing to Scale an Indian AgriTech Startup with $335k ARR
ev.evidence_quote: Freshconnect was an online B2B marketplace for fresh agricultural produce like fruits & vegetables.

execution.business_model: margin on cost price and delivery charges

ev.divergence_summary: Same idea, but struggled to transition from manual operations to tech-driven automation.
ev.lesson: Avoid relying heavily on manual processes when scaling, as it leads to unsustainable operational costs.
ev.relationship_reason: They serve the same customer segment in India.

ev.name: Plenti
ev.one_liner: An app-based surplus/unsold food marketplace for restaurants, bakeries, and supermarkets.
ev.source_title: Kerala-based start-up launches app to sell surplus/unsold food at restaurants and hotels - The Hindu
ev.evidence_quote: It lists restaurants, bakeries and supermarkets where surplus/unsold food, which would otherwise go to waste, is available and can be bought at one-third the original price.
ev.divergence_summary: Same idea, but Plenti intentionally avoids delivery to reduce carbon emissions and incentivize physical activity.
ev.lesson: Use partnerships with local trade associations like KHRA to gain legitimacy and vendor access early on.
ev.transfer: Use partnerships with local trade associations like KHRA to gain legitimacy and vendor access early on.
ev.relationship_reason: Both operate in the same geography and target surplus food redistribution.

ev.name: B-Stock
ev.one_liner: Auction-based marketplaces for businesses to sell overstock and returns.
ev.source_title: Top Platforms for Selling Excess Inventory in E-commerce
ev.evidence_quote: B-Stock runs auction-based marketplaces where businesses can sell overstock and returned goods directly to verified buyers.
ev.divergence_summary: Same idea, but they focus on retail returns and overstock via auctions rather than perishable food via SMS.
ev.lesson: Verified buyer networks ensure speed and reliability in clearing bulk inventory.
ev.transfer: Use auction-based mechanisms to efficiently clear time-sensitive surplus stock to verified buyers.
ev.relationship_reason: They provide a playbook for enterprise-level inventory liquidation that can be adapted for food.

ev.name: Faire
ev.one_liner: Wholesale marketplace connecting boutique brands with independent retailers.
ev.source_title: Top Platforms for Selling Excess Inventory in E-commerce
ev.evidence_quote: Faire connects boutique brands with independent retailers.
ev.divergence_summary: Same idea, but they focus on boutique goods rather than perishable food products.
ev.lesson: Curated connections improve the match quality between small suppliers and buyers.
ev.transfer: Implement a curated platform approach to connect artisanal producers directly with independent retail buyers.
ev.relationship_reason: Their model for connecting small brands with buyers is highly applicable to the founder's food platform.

ev.name: Full Harvest
ev.one_liner: B2B marketplace for surplus and imperfect produce between farms and food manufacturers.
ev.evidence_quote: Full Harvest founded by Christine Moseley to connect farms with food manufacturers and distributors for surplus and imperfect produce
ev.divergence_summary: Same goal, but targeted large-scale manufacturers instead of smallholder restaurants, facing higher procurement inertia.
ev.lesson: Relationship-intensive B2B industries require dominant price advantages to displace incumbent procurement channels.
ev.relationship_reason: Both aimed to facilitate direct trade between produce sources and buyers.

ev.name: PowerPeers
ev.one_liner: P2P electricity trading platform for local renewable energy exchange.
ev.evidence_quote: builds pilot marketplace connecting solar prosumers with local energy buyers in Amsterdam region.
ev.divergence_summary: Same matching mechanism for time-sensitive supply, but applied to electricity trading under strict license requirements.
ev.lesson: Local supply-demand matching requires navigating complex, sector-specific legal frameworks for trade authorization.
ev.transfer: Incorporate regulatory feasibility checks early to avoid building infrastructure that lacks necessary supply licenses.
ev.relationship_reason: Non-overlapping industry allows for sharing of matching mechanics and regulatory navigation strategies.

ev.name: Feed
ev.one_liner: A food-centric social commerce platform connecting independent culinary brands with consumers.
ev.source_title: The first food-focused social commerce app. | Feed | Product Hunt
ev.evidence_quote: Feed is the first food-centric social commerce platform.

execution.customer: food enthusiasts and independent culinary brands

ev.divergence_summary: Same idea, but Feed focuses on D2C home delivery for urban consumers rather than bulk trade.
ev.lesson: Use community features to build brand loyalty and social engagement around independent food producers.
ev.relationship_reason: Both operate as platforms facilitating direct connections between food producers and buyers.

ev.name: SimplyLocal
ev.one_liner: App connecting consumers to local farms for direct food purchases.
ev.evidence_quote: I made this app to make buying direct to consumer from farms & ranches alot simpler & smoother.
ev.divergence_summary: Same idea, but uses native mobile apps instead of SMS for communication.
ev.lesson: Focus on high-density data, like sorting by distance, to solve the discovery friction for buyers.
ev.relationship_reason: Both provide platforms for connecting consumers with local producers to facilitate direct trade.

ev.name: FoodCourt
ev.one_liner: Africa's leading virtual restaurant company utilizing virtual restaurants and dark stores.
ev.source_title: Food Tech Startups funded by Y Combinator (YC) 2026 | Y Combinator
ev.evidence_quote: Understanding the unique problems of the African on-demand/ food delivery market, we've taken a full-stack approach by controlling different areas of the value chain such as technology, production & delivery
ev.divergence_summary: Same idea, but FoodCourt controls the entire production and delivery chain internally.
ev.lesson: Controlling the full vertical allows for higher service consistency in fragmented markets.
ev.transfer: Borrow their full-stack approach of controlling production and delivery to ensure seamless and consistent quality service.
ev.relationship_reason: They serve different parts of the food value chain, potentially as buyer and supplier.
